purpose: External calibration targets for HVI scores: how the real world values each figure. Fame and popularity, not virtue. Use to test whether the rubric's balance tracks reality, never as a score input for private users.

sources.pageviews_12mo: Wikimedia Pageviews REST API, en.wikipedia, all-access, agent=user, monthly 20250901-20260831. Fame/attention proxy; spikes on deaths, scandals, anniversaries.
sources.wikipedia_language_editions: Wikidata sitelinks (wiki projects only). Breadth of cross-cultural notability; slow-moving.
sources.wikidata_awards_count: Distinct 'award received' (P166) values on Wikidata. Institutional recognition proxy; editing coverage is uneven.
sources.pantheon: MIT Pantheon 2.0 (pantheon.world), api.pantheon.world/person_ranks. HPI combines language editions, pageview age-adjustment and non-English views. rank_percentile is against all ranked people. Covers people with 15+ language editions.
sources.time_100_of_the_century: Time 100: The Most Important People of the Century (1999). English Wikipedia omits the full list, so membership = linked from BOTH the Russian and Japanese Wikipedia articles (QID match), which carry it.
sources.time_person_of_the_year: Years named (alone or as a named member of a group choice, e.g. Mandela in 1993's 'Peacemakers', Swift in 2017's 'Silence Breakers', Altman in 2025's 'Architects of AI'), parsed from the winner rows of Wikipedia 'Time Person of the Year'. Shortlists excluded.
sources.time_100_annual_wikidata: Wikidata P166=Q604370 (Time 100). Sparse; false means 'not recorded', not 'never listed'.
sources.hart_100_rank: Michael H. Hart, The 100 (1992 ed.). Only ranks 1-10 are public; null means 'not in top 10 or unknown'.
sources.yougov_us: YouGov Ratings public pages (yougov.com/en-us/topics/public_figure/...), US panel, rolling quarterly, plus the public rankings API (api-test.yougov.com/public-data/v5, 'all-time-people' and 'historical-figures' lists; all_time_people_rank = YouGov's own popularity rank). fame = % heard of; popularity = % positive; liked_share_of_aware = popularity/fame. Viewing is free; check YouGov's public-data license before republishing numbers.
sources.scm_warmth_competence: No free dataset found with per-person warmth/competence ratings for named public figures; SCM studies rate groups, not individuals.
